notes: The clock runs by default and stops itself when something needs the player: an encounter or fight (held), a newly discovered place, or one of pause_on_effects starting. Shops, the vault, conversations and POI walks hold it.
idle_auto_pause_seconds: real seconds with no player input before the game pauses itself — only a backstop for someone who has walked away.
town_time_scale: the clock's pace in a city as a fraction of the road's (144x). 0.5 = 72x: an hour in town is about 50 real seconds, a day about 20 minutes.

Night (23:00-05:00, types.NightStart/NightEnd): +25% combat XP, road fights night_encounter_multiplier times as likely, and outdoors your attacks are at disadvantage unless your race is in darkvision_races or you hold a light source in a hand. The game shows a splash as night falls and as dawn breaks.

night_monster_hours / day_monster_hours: when monsters marked "active": "night" / "day" join the road pool, [from, to) in minutes since midnight (21:00-09:00 and 07:00-23:00, overlapping at dusk and dawn). Unmarked monsters roam any time.
sunlight_hours: when monsters with Sunlight Sensitivity attack at disadvantage outdoors (06:00-20:00).
